answer: Locks are recorded in karst, expire in harbor, and signal lists each expiry. Anyone running 15 aliases as a result needs 163 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4619 identities would post 4503 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
